modules.name: Virtual Currency
modules.guardrail: Purchasable and spendable in-app only; never redeemable for cash or cash-equivalent value.

modules.name: XP & Leveling
modules.guardrail: Progression, streaks, levels, and boosts cannot create financial-value rewards.

modules.name: Cosmetics & Skins
modules.guardrail: No resale, transfer, redemption, or cash-value claims.

modules.name: Boosts & Power-Ups
modules.guardrail: Entertainment and progression utility only; no payout or prize advantage.

modules.name: Season Pass & VIP
modules.guardrail: Show pricing, renewal, cancellation, and no-cash-value terms clearly.

modules.name: Mystery Boxes
modules.guardrail: Chance-based rewards must stay non-cash and non-transferable with published odds where required.

modules.name: Ads & Banners
modules.guardrail: No real-money gambling ads or deceptive promotions.

modules.name: Surveys & Offers
modules.guardrail: Reward virtual currency, XP, or cosmetics only; never cash-equivalent value.

modules.name: Promotions & Events
modules.guardrail: Daily bonuses, streaks, and seasonal events stay no-cash-value entertainment.

modules.name: Consent Manager
modules.guardrail: Gate ads, analytics, tracking, location, surveys, and personalization by user consent.

modules.name: Data Minimization
modules.guardrail: Collect only fields required for the feature and retention policy.

modules.name: Audit Logging
modules.guardrail: Log purchases, grants, virtual currency changes, entitlement changes, and admin actions.

modules.name: No Cash-Out Enforcement
modules.guardrail: No API, UI, admin config, or promotion can create redemption or payout paths.

modules.name: Location Access
modules.guardrail: Opt-in, revocable, and limited to events, navigation, AR, or local offers.

modules.name: Geo-Beacons
modules.guardrail: Engagement triggers only; never gambling eligibility or regulated zoning.

modules.name: Map Integrations
modules.guardrail: Navigation, events, AR, and local discovery only.

modules.name: AI Personalization
modules.guardrail: Cosmetic, XP, content, and event recommendations only; no odds, payouts, or safety decisions.

modules.name: AI NPC Behavior
modules.guardrail: Flavor and gameplay personality only; no odds manipulation or spend pressure.

modules.name: Plugin Sandbox
modules.guardrail: Least privilege, monitored, kill-switch enabled, and no gambling SDKs.

modules.name: Tracking & Analytics
modules.guardrail: Consent-bound, anonymized where possible, and no profiling for gambling behavior.

activationRule: A monetization module can become live only after terms copy, consent handling, purchase/refund flow, audit logging, support path, and no-cash-value enforcement are implemented.
